finding.text: The task folder can't be continued from git: `investigation.md`, `past-work.md` and `review/` are untracked in the main tree and missing from `worktree/single-voice`. Commit them with the task.

The "Investigate first" asks were never done. investigation.md stops at pass 1: its timings are "read from the code, not yet measured". Its Pass 2 list (one real session timed, the SDK no-text check, the reply queue, turn-taking prior art, findings written into `ux/Dictate/doc/`) is all unticked. So the owner's "stall, then burst" question has no measured answer. Do pass 2, or file it as a task on the session.

Ask 6 and the 16:10 ask ("it reads the framework readme and its own role readme", "it reads the mastermind readme so it knows the spawn tools") are not met. The spawn spec has `sdk: { tools: [] }` (Sessions.js, `single ?` spec), so the agent cannot read any file. The brief (`Servex/agents/single-voice-assistant.md:55-57`) names its own files but gives it no way to read them. Inline the few lines it needs, or give it Read.

The brief teaches moves that Chat V3 doesn't draw: `to: "paragraph"`, `to: "card"` and `edit: "move"` (`single-voice-assistant.md:18-31`). plan.md "Built" admits that V3 draws no move or card from `place`. So two of the three silent filing moves the owner asked for (ask 3: new paragraph, new card, move) change nothing on screen, and each still costs a Sonnet turn. Either add the verb that V3 reads ("add a tool verb if one is missing"), or cut those moves from the brief until V3 draws them. Also, the "starts a card" sentence at :18 is followed by a paragraph example, not a card one.

The 16:10 "context cards built step by step" asks are only partly met. Nothing is built or tested for: add a card, add a paragraph to that card by its id, add a Ref to a task, child session or page. The ids test (`Sessions.single.test.mjs:439-443`) only covers a top-level `tasks.add`, but the owner asked for "every `add`, at any depth".

Unbuilt owner asks are recorded only as prose in "Not built yet" (`ux/Dictate/doc/single-voice-assistant.md:19-20`). These are Ref cards, the grey/green check and no 🧠 in single (ask 5), cards that absorb walls, the read-aloud follow-up, and heard-only context. Law 10 and "file each ask" need each one filed as a task on the session, so none is lost.

Stale doc: `ux/Dictate/doc/fast-and-smart.md:5` still says `session-assistant.txt` takes `voice`, `fast` or `off`, and doesn't mention `single`. `ux/Dictate/doc/settings.md` doesn't list the new `assistant` knob on `/api/session/settings`. `ux/Dictate/doc/map.md:32` (the "every dictation piece" map) has no row for the new role. The comment at `Servex/agents/Sessions.js:84` also still reads "the word off, fast or voice".

The pause cue fires after every pause, whether or not a question is open (`single_cue`), so each pause costs one extra Sonnet turn just to say nothing. The owner asked for "the cheapest way to say nothing". Gating the cue in code, for example only after a "?" sentence or an open Question since the last reply, would skip most of those turns.

The cue is timed from when each sentence reaches Servex (`single_pause_ms` after `single_say`), not from the owner's silence. The floor's `quiet` event (ux/Dictate/floor.js), which `answer_quiet_ms` already uses, is closer to "about 1 s of silence".

The "own write" check (`Sessions.single.test.mjs:455`) only asserts `!tail`. It doesn't prove that the item tool's write never comes back to the writer through `updates`/`follow`, which is what the owner asked.

The test writes a temp folder into the live site tree under a hard-coded date (`public/framework/ai/sessions/2026/11/02/.single-voice-test-<pid>`, test :421). The dev server's watcher will see it. A tmp repo root passed to `run_item` would be safer, if `run_item` allows one.

The 16:20 fold-in is not addressed: correcting an early-sent sentence when Whisper's final text differs. The brief's clean path (`place` + `improve`) could serve it, but nothing wires Whisper's correction to it.

The dual path checks out. Every gate now takes `s`, dual-only behaviour is keyed on `assistant_of(s) === "off"`, and the existing tests pass: `Sessions.test.mjs` 29/29 and `Sessions.single.test.mjs` 11/11, run in the worktree.
